'''Emergency medical technicians''' were [[Medic/Legends|medical]] personnel of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]]. About 1,500 emergency technicians served aboard the [[Modular taskforce cruiser]] when serving a [[Hospital module|hospital]] [[Mission Function Module|module mission]].
